items.headline: Niners LB Dre Greenlaw's appeal of suspension rejected, will sit vs. Commanders
items.body: Niners linebacker Dre Greenlaw will serve his one-game suspension in Monday night's game against the Commanders after the NFL denied his appeal Tuesday.

items.headline: Tyreek Hill found liable for 2 of 10 counts in battery trial; wife awarded $500K
items.body: A Miami jury returned a mixed verdict in the assault and battery civil trial against Tyreek Hill, finding the former NFL receiver liable for two counts of battery but not liable for the eight other claims made by his estranged wife, Lakeeta Vaccaro.

items.headline: Cleveland Browns gets their close-up in first trailer for Hulu's 'The Land'
items.body: Created by Dan Fogelman, the NFL-backed drama follows a fictional version of the Browns and premieres the day after Super Bowl LXI.

items.headline: Broncos' Bo Nix says he needs to simplify approach, play faster amid rocky start
items.body: Broncos quarterback Bo Nix said Tuesday he can find solutions if he can simplify his approach: "Making it simple, making things 1-2-3, and let's play fast and let's roll."

items.headline: Panthers RT Moton coughed up blood before clot diagnosis
items.body: Carolina Panthers right tackle Taylor Moton, 32, told reporters Tuesday that he coughed up blood before being diagnosed with multiple blood clots in June, an ailment that sidelined him through training camp and into the second month of the regular season.

items.headline: Saints owner Gayle Benson rips 1-4 start, says fans 'deserve better'
items.body: Saints owner Gayle Benson called out several members of the organization amid the team's 1-4 start and said that fans are "right to expect more than we have delivered."

items.headline: Micah Parsons: 'Jayden Daniels probably cost my man Dan Quinn his job'
items.body: Micah Parsons said on his podcast that Jayden Daniels' mistake at the end of overtime Sunday will probably end up getting Commanders coach Dan Quinn fired.

items.headline: The Saints' offense keeps declining each week. Can they turn it around?
items.body: After dropping three straight games at home, New Orleans goes on the road with intent to turn things around.

items.headline: Bills' Joe Brady warns RB James Cook of 'consequences' for costly fumbles
items.body: Bills coach Joe Brady said RB James Cook has done a lot of "good things" this season but warned his star runner about the "consequences" of his fumbling issues.

items.headline: NFL suspends Rams' Alaric Jackson for two games after punch
items.body: The NFL on Tuesday suspended Rams left tackle Alaric Jackson for two games without pay after he punched Bills outside linebacker Bradley Chubb following Monday night's game in Los Angeles.

items.headline: Bears DE Montez Sweat suspended two games for violating NFL's PED policy
items.body: The NFL has issued a two-game suspension to Bears defensive end Montez Sweat for violating the league's policy on performance-enhancing substances.

items.body: A recruiting report on Brian Flores has examples of what his lawyers say are racial stereotypes that NFL teams use when evaluating Black coaching candidates.

items.headline: Zxavian Harris eligible to sign with NFL teams despite bid to play for LSU
items.body: The NFL has reversed course and now says that former Ole Miss DL Zxavian Harris is free to sign with teams this season after a failed attempt to return to college football at LSU.

items.headline: Bengals tight end Tanner Hudson out for season with torn pec
items.body: Bengals TE Tanner Hudson suffered a torn pectoral in last Sunday's win over the Dolphins that will sideline him for the season, his agent told ESPN.
